integrity: The parameter comparison is proved by matching the branch divisor of the tangent-plane double cover with the branch divisor in Skorobogatov's six-point Kummer model. Symbolic identities are replayed by the included checker; published geometric inputs are separately cited.
scientific_limitations: The result is over \(\mathbb C\), excludes the five discriminant directions, and does not analyze degeneration at those directions. A residual literature risk is an equivalent all-directions Kummer-coordinate calculation under different notation.
title: The sixth Weierstrass point is the cotangent-level parameter
